WEBSSO
Description
The WEBSSO namespace deals with APM module SSO processing.
Command List
WEBSSO::disable
- Forwards a request
without doing SSO processing on it.
WEBSSO::enable
- Causes APM to do the
SSO processing on a request.
WEBSSO::select
- Use specified SSO
configuration object to do SSO for the HTTP request
